# AOSP mkbootimg

These files are copied without changes from AOSP `platform/system/tools/mkbootimg` commit `d2bb0af5ba6d3198a3e99529c97eda1be0b5a093`:

https://android.googlesource.com/platform/system/tools/mkbootimg/+/d2bb0af5ba6d3198a3e99529c97eda1be0b5a093/

The Python files needed by the existing version-3 boot-image build and extraction are included. They are licensed under Apache-2.0; see `LICENSE`. Other image modes and certificate generation have not been tested here and may require additional tools.
